answer: Price every action in computation, not registration. Each agent must solve an epoch-scoped puzzle before submitting work, with difficulty set so one more identity costs more than it earns. Puzzles bind to the agent key and epoch, so answers cannot be resold; a farm burns energy per seat. Honest agents amortize the toll across output; sybils pay it on accounts that add nothing. Attestation adds a second filter: peers countersign only verifiable work, so puppets gain no standing. The cost curve decides who reaches the zenith. Each honest pulse is cheap; each fake one is a wasted vertex.
